//: Lighthouse CI config for the admin portal (admin-portal-redesign Req 13.7, 13.8).
collect.url lists every redesigned admin route so the accessibility = 100 gate
is enforced PER ROUTE: Lighthouse CI reports each URL separately, so a score
< 100 on ANY audited route fails `categories:accessibility` and blocks merge,
identifying the offending URL in the report.
AUTH LIMITATION (no fabricated auth): all admin routes below are RBAC-gated
(min role Receptionist, including `/`). Audited against the live subdomain
WITHOUT a session, each route 30x/redirects to the sign-in page, so an
unauthenticated run effectively audits the sign-in page under each URL label
rather than the real route content. The gate therefore guarantees a11y = 100
on whatever each URL renders unauthenticated (at minimum `/`). To obtain true
per-route authenticated scores, supply a session to LHCI (e.g. a
collect.puppeteerScript that signs in, or pre-set session cookies/headers) —
intentionally NOT wired here because no real credentials are fabricated.
The full route list is kept so the per-route gate activates automatically once
